body.label: Target
body.html: One creature within weapon range and line of sight.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within weapon range. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage and ignore 1 Defense from equipment.

surges.html: If the primary target is Locked by you, deal +1 weapon damage.
On a success, the target's equipment-granted Defense is reduced by 1 until the start of its next turn.

rider.title: EXECUTION
rider.html: If the target is Locked by you, you may end that Lock after rolling. If you do and this Action succeeds, treat 1 damage from the Action as Breach and the target becomes Exposed.
